because: No official or standard grouping counts eleven valley-floor AVAs in Napa. Napa Valley has 17 nested AVAs (Crystal Springs of Napa Valley became the 17th in November 2024), and most of them are mountain or hillside AVAs. Only a handful straddle the floor between Highway 29 and the Silverado Trail: Oak Knoll, Yountville, Oakville, Rutherford, St. Helena and Calistoga, with Stags Leap lying east of the Trail. A candidate would learn a false count from this stem. The keyed answer itself is right.
